intro.en: Heavy rain comes every season where it is documented. These are the things to keep doing so that it causes less harm; they hold all year, not only when rain is expected.
intro.sw: Mvua kubwa huja kila msimu pale ilipoandikwa. Haya ni mambo ya kuendelea kufanya ili isilete madhara makubwa; yanashikilia mwaka mzima, si tu mvua inapotarajiwa.

en: Keep the drains and water channels around the home clear of waste all year.
Store food, documents and valuables above floor level, in sealed containers.
Repair the roof and tie down loose sheets before each rainy season.
Keep children away from open drains, pits and swollen streams during the rains.
sw: Wekeni mitaro na njia za maji kuzunguka nyumba zikiwa wazi bila taka mwaka mzima.
Hifadhini chakula, nyaraka na vitu vya thamani juu ya sakafu, kwenye vyombo vilivyofungwa.
Karabatini paa na fungeni mabati yaliyolegea kabla ya kila msimu wa mvua.
Waweke watoto mbali na mitaro iliyo wazi, mashimo na vijito vilivyojaa wakati wa mvua.

en: Open drainage furrows in the fields and plant along the contour on slopes.
Keep seed and fodder in a dry, raised store.
sw: Fungueni mifereji ya kutolea maji shambani na pandeni kwa kufuata kontua kwenye miteremko.
Hifadhini mbegu na malisho kwenye ghala kavu lililoinuliwa.

who.sw: Kamati za kijiji, mtaa na kata

en: Hold a drain-clearing day with residents before each rainy season and keep culverts and footbridges open.
Keep the list of households that need help to move, and the safe places and routes, up to date.
sw: Fanyeni siku ya kusafisha mitaro pamoja na wakazi kabla ya kila msimu wa mvua na wekeni makalavati na vidaraja vikiwa wazi.
Sasisheni orodha ya kaya zinazohitaji msaada kuhama, na mahali salama na njia zake.

en: Clear and repair culverts, drains and river crossings every dry season; keep schools, clinics and markets drained.
Share TMA's seasonal outlook with wards and farmers in good time.
sw: Safisheni na karabatini makalavati, mitaro na vivuko vya mito kila kiangazi; hakikisheni shule, zahanati na masoko hayatuamishi maji.
Shirikisheni kata na wakulima mwelekeo wa msimu wa TMA kwa wakati.

en: Agree on a safe place and the way to it, and walk the route together once a year.
Keep a radio, a charged phone and the leaders' numbers at hand through the rainy season.
sw: Kubalianeni mahali salama na njia ya kufika, na mtembee njia hiyo pamoja mara moja kwa mwaka.
Wekeni redio, simu iliyochajiwa na namba za viongozi karibu msimu wote wa mvua.

en: Put the wards with the heaviest rain first in the drainage, road and school-repair budgets, and keep a response team ready for the season.
sw: Wekeni kata zenye mvua nyingi zaidi mbele kwenye bajeti za mitaro, barabara na ukarabati wa shule, na wekeni timu ya kukabiliana tayari kwa msimu.
